# Failure observer: the generated API raises a neutral failure event; tracing plugs in outside the runtime
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #165, sha256:ad5495496e80134ed40e008e17f9a6dfb1da56c1aef80fa687524174f78f8f07). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Ready
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** feature (thin slice; split from card 161 by Decider D112)
- **Milestone:** Purpose: verifiability, preserved intent and reviewability
- **Source:** Product design principle recorded 2026-10-28 (Decider D112): invert the dependency through an interface layer, so the runtime stays ignorant of Phrase and tracing is pluggable; production wires a no-op or a plain logging sink with no source leak.
- **Depends on:** 161
- **Story:** As Morgan, I want a production failure log line to carry a neutral failure code, endpoint name, opaque step id and build id, so that I can resolve it to the spec offline with the source map and phrase trace without the running API exposing any source detail.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given the generated runtime, When a declared failure is decided, Then an observer interface owned by the generated code is called after the decision with a neutral event (schema version, failure code, endpoint name, opaque step id reused from the card 161 source map, build id), the event carries no request data, no exception message, no Phrase file name, line or spec text, the generated host registers a no-op by default, and an observer that throws or is slow cannot change the response (tests for both)
  2. Given the live test runner and phrase trace tooling, When a tracing observer is registered, Then it resolves every declared failure of the Tasks demo (EmptyTitle, TitleTooLong, NotFound, StoreUnavailable) to the exact Phrase line and endpoint through the source map, and a plain logging sink produces a production-shaped log line that phrase trace resolves offline
  3. Given the demo and orders outputs, When the observer lands, Then the 422 bodies and the 11 specs are byte-identical, the README drift test and the Usable v1 bars stay green, and the recorded orders output hash is re-checked and re-recorded honestly with the exact runtime change named

## Context

- Reuse the step ids of card 161; do not invent a second id scheme. Other adapters (Minimal APIs, other languages) mirror the abstraction, so keep the interface and event small. Security sign-off by a security-role reviewer is part of the Decider record.
